accounting.rationale: Original PDF130 lines16-17 defines named-constant identity and its value/conversion relation. Canonical constant-expression and initialization owners retain those effects; no local no-op classifier or copied conversion test is introduced.
PARAMETER confers named-constant identity, distinct from a variable, coarray or procedure. Both declaration and PARAMETER-statement routes retain their actual rules.
PENDING source relation to R805/C1012,10.1.12 and8.6.11. A pure function or a variable token does not by itself establish or refute constant-expression status.
Conversion is conditional, not evidence that every constant expression requires a representation change.
Type conformance and intrinsic-assignment conversion remain8.2p4 and10.2.1.2/.3; no numeric-kind or storage-width model is supplied here.
Type parameter agreement/conversion and CHARACTER length rules retain their canonical premises. Constant-expression and LEN/KIND obligations are not interchangeable.

Implied-shape initialization still requires matching rank; other named arrays require a scalar or conforming-shape expression under8.2p4/8.6.11p3. This is not arbitrary reshaping or runtime allocation.
The written subject is a length type parameter. KIND constancy has its own general C701 owner.
A procedure-local restricted expression is not enough when this named-constant constraint requires a constant expression.
Original PDF131 lines1-2 combines the previous-definition requirement with the permission for that definition to be earlier in the same statement.
Reference uses the data value under5.4.5. A property inquiry that does not use that value is not automatically the same event.
An earlier definition in the same statement is allowed. This is not permission to read a later or self-dependent value; inquiry/prior-specification exceptions retain10.1.12 ownership.
The actual unnumbered note is on PDF131, following p2; it is not a continuation of another note. All three declaration examples remain informative, not additional executions.
ONE and Y illustrate scalar constant expressions. The real division is not a promise of an exact rational value, binary representation or kind identifier.
ORDER illustrates an array constant and a constructor, retaining the canonical constructor/type/rank/initialization rules.

DEFAULT requires a complete prior NODE definition and a valid constant structure constructor. A NULL-initialized pointer component does not give the whole named constant the POINTER attribute or authorize target-value access.

requirements.title: A PARAMETER entity is not a variable, coarray or procedure
requirements.definition: An entity with PARAMETER is neither a variable nor a coarray nor a procedure. Entity role is established by the full declaration context, not by a spelling or one attempted use. A constant structure can contain a permitted pointer component without becoming a pointer entity itself.

pending.named-constant-admission: PENDING complete INTEGER scalar/array and qualified derived-type named-constant admissions with actual constant expressions and valid initialization/type/shape. Reuse canonical initialization evidence when adequate; no no-op classifier or duplicate constructor case.
pending.variable-role-source: PENDING exact named-constant-versus-variable classification and canonical variable-definition-context relations. An assignment to a constant is invalid in its variable context, but does not by itself establish an isolated C852 declaration-role violation. A repair removing PARAMETER must leave a complete valid variable declaration; source/owner/reporting isolation precedes any fixture.
pending.coarray-role-source: PENDING a complete PARAMETER-plus-coarray declaration contrast, with a noncoarray named-constant repair. Adjudicate C823's variable/component premise and C826 storage/role overlap explicitly before claiming isolation. An unsupported coarray configuration or unrelated initialization error is not a C852 report.
pending.procedure-role-control: PENDING an otherwise valid INTEGER EXTERNAL procedure declaration followed by a separate PARAMETER definition for the same entity, repaired by removing EXTERNAL so it is a legitimate INTEGER named constant. Confirm the procedure-role predicate and all PARAMETER-statement rules; no unresolved-link or mere-name-use oracle.
pending.pointer-component-boundary: PENDING the original NODE-style constant structure with a valid NULL pointer component under10.1.12 and16.9.155. Check only permitted constant values/status properties if a meaningful canonical witness exists; never dereference its disassociated component or classify the parent as a variable/procedure/pointer solely because of the component.

requirements.oracle: Source-qualified role exclusions and complete minimal valid controls, with explicit canonical overlap gates. A numbered constraint is retained without manufacturing a uniquely isolated negative where another role/grammar condition is inseparable.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Reporting capability does not mandate fatal exit, exact English or a printed code. Cause and legitimate source origins must be established without span widening, line coalescing, source-echo, unsupported-feature, ICE or unrelated-error credit. No existing roles or approvals are changed.

requirements.title: Named-constant length parameters and array-bound expressions are constant
requirements.definition: An expression specifying a length type parameter or array bound of a named constant is a constant expression. This is not weakened to an arbitrary procedure-local specification expression. Canonical KIND requirements and nonexpression forms such as an allowed assumed CHARACTER length retain their own definitions and restrictions.

pending.constant-length-control: PENDING complete default-CHARACTER named constants with literal or previously defined named-constant LEN, and a qualified PDT length-parameter source relation. Zero length is not invalid; a negative constant CHARACTER length has the canonical zero-length interpretation rather than a C853 error.
pending.constant-bounds-control: PENDING named arrays with literal/constant-expression upper and lower bounds, including nonunit/negative bounds and a zero extent, plus implied-shape constant lower bounds. Complete initialization must have the required rank/type/kind; runtime allocation is not a control.
pending.variable-length-exclusion: PENDING a subprogram with a prior nonoptional INTEGER INTENT(IN) dummy n, a CHARACTER(n) declaration for c, and a separate PARAMETER(c='AB') definition. Repair only the length expression to constant2. The separate PARAMETER statement avoids confusing R803 initialization with C808, but all typing/automatic-object interactions still need explicit source review before a causal contract.
pending.variable-bounds-exclusion: PENDING prior INTEGER n as a nonconstant ordinary dummy and a prior rank-one declaration a(n), followed by PARAMETER(a=17); repair only n in the bound to3. Separately qualify an implied-shape lower-bound variant and constant lower repair. Procedure context makes some specification expressions legal, not these named-constant bounds.
pending.constant-inquiry-control: PENDING a prior ordinary fixed-shape array basis(3) and a named constant or named-constant bound using SIZE(basis), with all prior-specification conditions met. The inquiry can be constant without defined element values. C814_valid__automatic_save_size_constant is related constancy evidence, not already a C853 named-constant witness; preserve its owner and role.
pending.kind-assumed-deferred-boundaries: PENDING the precise C701 KIND, C702 deferred-parameter and7.4.4.2 assumed-CHARACTER-length relations. A permitted '*' for a named constant derives length from its constant value and is not a nonconstant expression. A colon or unsupported kind is not automatically a C853 negative; those predicates retain canonical owners.

requirements.oracle: Complete constant controls and minimally repaired nonconstant LEN/bound candidates, with exact source constancy determined from the particular expression/property. Each negative retains its named-constant subject and independently valid type/rank/initializer context.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No generic constant/kind/expected-message shortcut, default-kind number or byte assumption. A variable token can occur in a constant-property inquiry; a PURE function is not automatically a constant expression. Use supported precise origins and causal contracts, without opting in roles or forcing metadata.

requirements.title: A named-constant value is referenced only after its definition
requirements.definition: A named constant is not referenced before it has been defined; a prior definition in the same statement is permitted. Reference means use of its data value, not every appearance of a name. Type/property inquiry and prior-specification rules remain distinct from using a not-yet-defined constant value.

pending.prior-statement-use: PENDING a complete typed INTEGER parameter first=2 followed by second=first+3, with independently known values2/5 in meaningful positive controls. Preserve canonical declaration/initialization owners and use no compile-time kind folklore.
pending.same-statement-earlier-definition: PENDING prior INTEGER typing of first/second followed by PARAMETER(first=2,second=first+3), or the corresponding legal type-declaration form. The earlier same-statement definition is not replaced by a whole-statement unordered dependency model.
pending.forward-reference-source-gate: PENDING the reversed constant-definition order with both names typed beforehand, repaired by reordering the definitions or supplying an earlier definition. Establish the exact numbered/scope diagnostic basis or approved policy before rejection metadata; an undeclared-name/type error, generic constancy complaint or link failure is not the same predicate.
pending.value-property-and-scope-boundary: PENDING exact5.4.5 value-reference versus specification-inquiry conditions, including10.1.12p2's within-initialization exception and prior specification/host-use context. Do not ban all self/name appearances merely because the final constant value is not yet available. No no-op inquiry classifier or blanket mandatory prose rejection.

requirements.oracle: Complete prior-definition and same-statement admissions with literal values, and a finite source/reporting gate for an otherwise well-typed reversed-order contrast. Source-only relationships remain pending until a legitimate mechanism and role are adjudicated.
requirements.oracle_limitation: The prose requirement alone does not prescribe fatal rejection or a universal message. No undefined-value experiment, recursive self-oracle, cloned initialization case, source-span workaround or silent role promotion is allowed.
